post.summary:
A proxy renews its certificate with a NEW key: the request carries a CSR and is signed with the
current key. The previous key stays valid until the new one has been used.

post.description: Re-encrypts every sealed value (tenant secrets, TOTP secrets, SSO client secrets, git tokens) with the current key. Afterwards the old key can be removed from the configuration.

200.description: Server-Sent Events: `data: {"kind": "audit" | "report" | "resync"}` whenever something visible to the caller changed; a comment line every 15 s keeps the connection open

delete.summary:
Archives a tenant (see migration `0018`): it needs `tenants:delete`, a tenant without agents, and it
revokes what could still reach it (enrollment keys, tenant-scoped API tokens, role assignments)
and stops its tenant-owned content sources. Audit events and policy versions are kept.

get.summary:
Render every template resource of the agent's effective policy the way the agent will, except
that secrets are masked and the host facts are placeholders (the Core does not know them). The
Core only renders text here; it never applies anything.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The group or agent name; required for those scopes.

effective_version.description: Version of the last compiled policy for this agent.

proxy.description: Proxy that serves this agent, if it enrolled through one.

reported_at.description: Unix seconds of the last report.

shadows_global.description: A tenant artifact that hides a global one of the same name.

Assignment.description: A role held by a user, globally (`tenant` absent) or for one tenant.

reported_at.description: Unix seconds of the last report.

state.description: `drifted` (reported, not compliant) or `silent` (never reported, or not for a while).

occurred_at_micros.description: Microseconds since the Unix epoch, as hashed.

prev_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the previous event (absent for the first).

next.description: Pass as `before` to get the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the CA certificate.

issued_certificates.description: Agents whose own certificate was issued by it.

missing.description: Agents that do not trust it yet, up to 50 (`tenant/agent`).

applied.description: False for a removal that was reported but not applied (`prune` is off).

csr_pem.description: PEM CSR made by the agent with a locally generated Ed25519 key.

enc_public_key.description: age recipient (`age1...`) that policy secrets are encrypted to.

signing_keys.description: Lines of `<kid> <base64 public key>` for the agent's trusted-keys file.

key.description: Shown only now: hand it to the installer.

cookie.description: Also set the session cookie and return a CSRF token.

known_by.description: Agents that reported knowing this key within the last 7 days.

missing.description: Agents that have not (yet), up to 50, as `tenant/agent`.

cookie.description: Also set the session as an `HttpOnly` cookie and return a CSRF token (for browsers).

csrf_token.description: Cookie sessions: send it as `X-CSRF-Token` on every unsafe request.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds. While `mfa_required`, the time left to give the second factor.

mfa_required.description: The password was right but a TOTP or recovery code must follow (`POST /v1/auth/mfa`).

group.description: Group (or app role) name as it appears in the groups claim.

tenant.description: Tenant the role applies to; absent = global.

mfa_enabled.description: A second factor is set up.

permissions.description: Permissions of the global assignments (they apply to every tenant).

tenants.description: Permissions granted by tenant-scoped assignments, per tenant name.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code or an unused recovery code.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://` URI to render as a QR code.

secret.description: Base32 secret to type into an authenticator app.

groups.description: Groups for agents created by enrollment.

max_uses.description: How many agents may enroll with it (default 1).

yaml.description: Policy in the YAML authoring format (docs/POLICY.md).

dns_names.description: DNS names of the proxy's HTTPS and NATS endpoints, as agents will use them.

expires_in_days.description: Lifetime in days, 1 to 365 (tokens always expire).

permissions.description: Permissions the token may use; each must be held by its owner (in the tenant, if given).

tenant.description: Restrict the token to one tenant.

attention.description: Drifted agents first, then the silent ones (longest silent first); at most 20.

global_only.description: Only a global assignment can grant it.

approval_required.description: A save creates a draft that needs approval (otherwise it goes live at once).

active_version.description: Version the compiler uses; differs from the latest while a draft waits for approval.

live.description: `false` when the tenant requires approval: the version is a draft.

client_secret.description: Absent on update keeps the stored secret; a public client has none.

name.description: Slug used in URLs; ignored on update.

redirect_uri.description: Register this redirect URI at the identity provider.

key.description: Shown only now: hand it to the proxy installer. Valid 24 hours, single use.

csr_pem.description: PEM CSR made by the proxy with a locally generated Ed25519 key.

nats_url.description: NATS URL of the Core, for the proxy's own connection.

last_seen.description: Unix seconds of the last request from the proxy.

recovery_codes.description: Shown once; each works one time in place of a TOTP code.

error.description: Why rendering failed (for example an undefined variable).

output.description: The rendering, with secrets masked; absent when rendering failed.

Resolution.description: One variable as an agent sees it, and where it comes from.

ignored.description: Higher layers that tried to override a constant and were ignored.

overrides.description: Lower layers that define the same name and lose to `source`.

name.description: Required on create; ignored on update (the name is in the path).

scope.description: `global`, `tenant` or `any`: where the role may be assigned.

current_recipient.description: Age recipient (public key) new data is sealed to.

items.description: Sealed values per kind, and how many still need an old key.

oneOf.description: The key policies are signed with.

agents_reporting.description: Agents with a fresh report / all agents.

published.description: Keys announced to agents so they can switch to them.

retiring.description: Key ids agents are told to forget.

auth_token.description: Access token for https remotes; absent on update keeps the stored one, empty removes it.

kind.description: `directory` (a name under the Core's content directory) or `git`. Ignored on update.

location.description: directory: folder name; git: `https://` (or `file://` when allowed) URL.

poll_secs.description: Sync every N seconds (at least 30); absent = only on demand.

tenant.description: Make the source tenant-owned (it can only touch that tenant). Ignored on update.
Owning tenant; absent for a platform source.

roles.description: Replaces the user's roles in this tenant.

approval_required.description: New policy versions need approval by a second person before they go live.

assignments.description: Replaces the whole set of assignments when present.

locked.description: A constant: lower layers cannot override it.

target.description: The group or agent name; empty for `global` and `tenant`.

first_bad.description: Sequence number of the first event that does not match the chain.

approval_required.description: The tenant requires approval before a version goes live (readable by anyone who can read the policy).

active.description: The version the compiler currently uses.
